text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory tackled today's training 
menu with a run packed with even more 
spirit than usual.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Phew! According to the plan, that wraps 
it up for today... but!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've still got plenty in the 
tank today! Can we keep going for just a 
bit longer!?
choice_data_list:
Sure, but don't push yourself too hard, 
okay?
Sure, but don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm all good! I'm extra fired up today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. You know how I ran in that mock 
race for the TV special the other day?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My dad was watching that too. He called me 
last night and gave me a compliment!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—What impressed your father the most... 
well, yeah. It was how you never lost 
yourself, even when facing girls that 
fast.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's the same in kendo—one's heart wavers 
in the heat of battle. Overwhelm your 
opponent's spirit and you win; get 
overwhelmed and you lose. You used to be 
like that too, back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Still... that day, you just looked like 
you were having fun. Going all out, 
competing against a strong rival.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
A heart of absolute clarity! That's what 
makes you the strongest! ...You've grown 
into a splendid Umamusume, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—And so I told 'em! The reason I've got 
such a strong heart is...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to having such a 
passionate Trainer supporting me! After 
all, we're the greatest duo ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Since I said something so 
passionate, I'm extra fired up today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm gonna go back for seconds on 
training today~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Best Duo"... To always keep feeling 
that way, I resolved to continue guiding 
her with burning passion.
